name: Bounded similarity needs an input-range contract
pattern: A similarity score such as 1-|a-b|/M is treated as [0,1] although observed or upstream values can exceed the assumed range M.
risk: The score can become negative or change meaning; downstream weighted probability/MCDA inherits invalid scale assumptions.
gate: state the valid range of each input
verify upstream outputs obey it without hidden clipping
clip only when scientifically justified and report saturation
otherwise use a scale/metric valid for the observed range
